# Gurmehak Kaur — Software Engineer (Full Stack)

> Portfolio of Gurmehak Kaur, a full-stack software engineer based in Bengaluru, India, working with Go, React, Next.js and Node.js, open to remote work. The site covers her projects, work experience, resume and contact details.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gurmehak-web-portfolio.vercel.app/#home): Introduction — "Where Code Meets Creativity".
- [About](https://gurmehak-web-portfolio.vercel.app/#about): Background, tech stack and location.
- [Projects](https://gurmehak-web-portfolio.vercel.app/#projects): Selected work with live demos and source code.
- [Experience](https://gurmehak-web-portfolio.vercel.app/#experience): Internships and community roles.
- [Contact](https://gurmehak-web-portfolio.vercel.app/#contact): Contact form (name, email, message).

## Experience

- Full Stack Developer Intern, Rocket Global Technologies, Bengaluru (Jun 2026 – present): end-to-end mobile recharge workflow — Next.js interfaces, backend APIs, third-party vendor and payment integrations.
- Software Development Engineer Intern, Pratishthan Software Ventures, Bengaluru (Sep 2025 – Apr 2026): backend services and validation for UK payment systems (UKFPS, BACS, CHAPS, BCS), unit tests and CI/CD.
- Web Developer Intern, OneSnack (Jul 2024 – Dec 2024).
- Technical Team Member, Open Source Chandigarh (Sep 2023 – Jun 2024).

## Projects

- [Aarogya Care](https://aarogya-care-gamma.vercel.app/): MERN healthcare platform with JWT auth, role-based dashboards, 15+ REST APIs and Cloudinary uploads. [Admin panel](https://aarogya-care-admin.vercel.app/)
- [CompileX](https://compilex-azure.vercel.app/): Browser-based IDE with Judge0-backed multi-language execution. Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/gurmehakk20/CompileX)
- [ILMKOSH](https://ilmkosh.vercel.app/): Full-stack MERN online bookstore with REST APIs and validation. Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/gurmehakk20/ILMKOSH)
- [Floralia](https://floralia.vercel.app/): Florist e-commerce front end built with React and Tailwind CSS. Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/gurmehakk20/Floralia)
